title: A semi-implicit two dimensional solver for a covariant formulation of the shallow water equations
summary: In this paper we combine a flexible covariant formulation of the shallow water equations with the semi-implicit numerical scheme developed over the years by Casulli and collaborators. After adopting an orthogonal, but non-orthonormal, coordinate basis on two dimensional manifolds, and by writing the divergence of symmetric tensors in a way that avoids the introduction of Christoffel symbols, the shallow water equations preserve a very close resemblance to the usual one expressed in Cartesian coordinates.
